proposals.evidence: Turner specifically places Nepali hāmro, Awadhi hamar, Hindi hamārā and Bhojpuri hamār my in the extended asmāka possessive family. These Nepal/Terai hāmr-/hamār- forms match it, including nominative or singular usages in the survey; the Bhojpuri comparison already documents the shift to my.
